basic_info.description: Outstanding Potrero Hill Location! Not for the faint of heart, this Heavy fixer needs everything, but well worth the effort to bring it back to it's original condition and beyond. Brimming with potential, this 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom home offers 1015 square feet of living space plus a garage with room to expand. The RH-2 zoning may offer additional possibilities. Bring your creativity and vision to transform this property into your dream home. Whether you're an investor, developer or a DIY enthusiast, this is a fantastic opportunity to make your mark. Don't miss out on this exciting project! Downtown ViewS  93 Walk Score!! Offer Date 10/29 @12 Noon.
